using namespace std;

double difftimeval(const struct timeval *start, const struct timeval *end)
{
        double d;
        time_t s;
        suseconds_t u;

        s = start->tv_sec - end->tv_sec;
        u = start->tv_usec - end->tv_usec;
        //if (u < 0)
        //        --s;

        d = s;
        d *= 1000000.0;
        d += u;

        return d;
}
